flows.reason: assertNotVisible 'Household budget.xlsx' failed after tapping Delete: the sheet closes but FilesScreen passes onAction = { _, _ -> }, so nothing deletes and the row stays.

flows.behaviour: A snackbar reading 'Deleted <name>' with an Undo action appears after the row disappears.
flows.reason: assertVisible 'Deleted Household budget.xlsx' failed: no DeleteSnackbarHost exists, so no snackbar or Undo action is shown after Delete.

flows.behaviour: Tapping Undo puts the row back in the list at its sorted position.

flows.behaviour: The item sheet opened from Home > Recent files still shows no Delete tile.
